title: Voter turnout looks like a new low in Latvian parliamentary history
summary_full: Slightly more than half of the voters eligible to vote in Latvia's parliamentary election on October 3rd appear to have bothered to exercise their democratic right, raising serious questions about political engagement, media coverage and perhaps even whether people still value democracy as they did a generation ago.
